_doc: Camera shake per hit class (scripts/match/shake.gd, docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.d/1123-shake-table.md; --shake-check asserts it). Shake only comes from a big thing that happens TO you: never on your own casts, dashes or landings, and an explosion row only for something that truly explodes. door: what every shake shares. max_secs: how long a shake runs (s). max_amp: world units at power 1, full slider, on top of you. radius_m: past this distance nothing is felt; falloff linear: the strength drops linearly from full at the centre to 0 at radius_m. classes: class -> power (0-1, times max_amp x the falloff x the Screen shake slider, default 30%), step (power added per stage, lair_crack only), src (owner = an owner rule, decision = the brief's decision, ? = no reference number: the reference data documents no screen shake), at (the script files that may call it; a 0-power class has none).

self.what: anything you (your Boki, your Fuse) cause, on your own camera

light_hit.what: a light hit on you (Feel, ImpactWeight light)

solid_hit.what: a solid hit on you (Feel, ImpactWeight solid)

heavy_hit.what: a heavy hit on you: an ult, a slam, a payoff (Feel, ImpactWeight heavy)

knock.what: a knock (yours or on you): sound, feed and icon, no shake

hard_land.what: a landing from a height, anyone's

landing_strike.what: a landing attack's shock on bystanders (the Meteor Drop, Dredge's air smash, a Boki's landing strike); the struck still take their hit's tier

area_slam.what: an area ability landing that does not explode (a slam, a Fusion gust or wave; AbilityFx.land)

ult.what: an enemy Hunter's ult going off near you

fuse.what: an enemy Fuse taking form near you (offline and online alike)

fuse_shell_break.what: a fused enemy's shell breaking near you

explosion.what: a real blast near you: a Rimewright detonation, a Boki's big boom burst, a falling meteor

boss_slam.what: a boss ground blast under 3 m

boss_slam_wide.what: a boss ground blast of 3 m or more

boss_phase.what: a boss entering its next phase

lair_crack.what: a lair seal cracking, stronger per stage

train_hit.what: the train striking someone near you
